kinder.untertitel: Special assessment for determining care needs in infants, toddlers and adolescents under SGB XI.
kinder.altersvergleichText: Deducts the natural, age-related care needs of healthy children.
kinder.babyschutzText: Accounts for the flat upgrade for children under 18 months.
kinder.sonderregelText: Under 18 months the flat one-level upgrade applies. Care level 1 is excluded by law (direct entry at level 2).
kinder.assistentText: I help you record everything correctly for {name}.
kinder.gesperrtText: The raw data has been recorded. Unlock the professional SGB XI evaluation matrix and the ready-made application PDF for your care insurer.
kinder.vorteil1: Full comparison against the official children's reference tables.
kinder.vorteil2: Ready-drafted PDF cover letter for the initial application.
kinder.rechtlicherHintergrundText: For children, the additional effort is measured against a healthy child of the same age.
kinder.babyregelAngewandt: As your child is under 18 months, only the age-independent areas were assessed and the flat one-level upgrade is already included.
kinder.alleBereiche: All six statutory areas of life were assessed using the official module weightings.
kinder.briefErstellen: Create application letter in the letter centre

modul6.title: Module 6: Everyday life
modul6.weight: Legal context: safeguarding an SGB XI appeal
modul6.widerspruchText: This module does not change the calculated points directly, but it forms the legal basis for an appeal if the Medical Service recorded the care situation incompletely.
modul6.auswertungHinweis: When you start the evaluation, your data is calculated according to the SGB XI guidelines and compared with the state-specific relief amounts.
modul6.fussnote: © 2026 PflegeNavigator EU gUG • All calculations are based on the statutory thresholds of the Federal Ministry of Health.
